name: ActionCard
label: Action card
description: A change an assistant proposes and the reader confirms, then the record of what happened, with Undo while it can be reversed.

props.name: title
props.description: What the change is, with how much it touches: "Cancel orders: 69 orders". Collides with the native `title` tooltip attribute on purpose: the card shows it.

props.name: detail
props.description: A quiet line under the title: what the change leaves alone, and why ("Left as they are: 2 already shipped").

props.name: facts
props.description: What the change will do, a line each, as ActionReadout lists what one did: shown over Confirm, then kept, under the receipt, by the confirmed record. A dismissed or undone card is one row and shows none. Write them for the state the card is in.

props.name: icon
props.description: The leading mark: a Material Symbol name, or your own element.

props.name: status
props.description: Where the change stands. Fully controlled by design: the host makes the change, so it owns whether it was made. `proposed` offers Confirm and Dismiss; the others are the card's record. Defaults to `proposed`.

props.name: receipt
props.description: What the confirmed card says was done: "69 orders cancelled". Defaults to the title.

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour of Confirm: `destructive` for a change that takes something away (a cancellation, a refund). Defaults to `default`.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called by Confirm. The host makes the change, then sets `status` to `confirmed`.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called by Dismiss. The host sets `status` to `dismissed`; nothing changed.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Called by Undo on a confirmed card, shown only when this is set. The host reverses the change and sets `status` to `undone`.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The Confirm button's words. Defaults to "Confirm".

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: The Dismiss button's words. Not "Cancel", which beside a cancellation reads as the action itself. Defaults to "Dismiss".

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: The Undo button's words. Defaults to "Undo".

props.name: confirmedLabel
props.description: The read-out where Confirm stood, on a confirmed card that keeps its `facts`. Defaults to "Confirmed".

props.name: dismissedLabel
props.description: What a dismissed card says after its title. Defaults to "Not changed".

props.name: undoneLabel
props.description: What an undone card says after its title. Defaults to "Undone".
